$comment: WebSocket chunk-framing corpus, generated by scripts/fixtures/generate-chunks.ts. messages are base64 binary WebSocket messages fed in order; expected is the reassembled frame.

cases.name: y_three_chunks
cases.note: 3 messages; every non-final one carries a full capacity payload.

cases.name: y_small_message_ceiling
cases.note: The smallest ceiling the spec allows; non-final payloads are 2039 bytes.

cases.name: y_nonfinal_payload_at_minimum
cases.note: A non-final chunk with exactly 1024 payload bytes is the minimum a receiver accepts.

cases.name: n_count_exceeds_bound
cases.note: ceil(16 MiB / 1024) = 16384 is the most chunks a frame can need.

cases.name: n_nonfinal_payload_below_minimum
cases.note: A non-final chunk with 1023 payload bytes is refused on arrival.

cases.name: n_exceeds_frame_limit
cases.note: Four chunks of 2039 payload bytes; refused on the third, as soon as the accumulated payload passes 4096, without waiting for the last chunk.
